title: Prepare canonical XSD datatype value-constraint lexical forms
api_or_output: Internal charged constraint-lexical helper, retaining declared typed value, valid authored lexical and captured schema namespace context; unchanged public/frozen contracts

acceptance.description: Add a narrowly scoped internal helper that first validates declared authored lexical text through the supplied facet engine and registry, then prepares canonical assessment lexical forms. Keep value/lexical consistency internal; retain the declared typed value, owned assessment lexical string and immutable captured declaration namespace context. Do not add lexical storage to every parsed value or mutate published values. Existing actual-type TryValidate must assess the prepared lexical form, not only typed facets.

Implement the pinned XSD 1.0 Second Edition canonical mappings wherever specified, including primitive/derived numeric distinctions, booleans, binary, supported date/time forms, and composed list/selected-union values. For types without a prescribed 1.0 canonical mapping, retain a valid whitespace-normalized authored representative and captured context; do not invent QName prefixes or silently import XSD1.1 rules. Handle arbitrary precision and calendar boundaries without narrowing existing supported values.

Prove declared xs:int default01 becomes1 and satisfies a derived one-digit pattern; declared xs:decimal default1 becomes1.0 and fails actual xs:int lexical grammar. Include exact known outputs, cross-family equality preservation, list/union selected identity, QName declaration-vs-instance context, temporal timezone/year/leap boundaries and cultures; test checked capacities, component reservations, exact work boundaries and cancellation during long operations with null caps.

Keep helper scans/copies/formatting bounded under one supplied operation, explicit owned-result lifetimes and borrowed transient spans; add relevant controlled allocation evidence, independent source review and actual integrated correctness/API/normal/XML-only checks before consumers add dependency. No unmerged core implementation dependency, public/frozen interface changes, exclusions or rewritten historical evidence.
